name: Entebbe International Airport
before:
Uganda's only international airport, on the northern shore of Lake Victoria about 6 km south west of Entebbe town and around 40 km by road south west of central Kampala.

Plan for that road. Everything arriving in Uganda by air comes through here, and the capital is the better part of an hour away by the Entebbe-Kampala Expressway, so airport transfers are a real part of an itinerary rather than an afterthought.

The airport handled 1,069,224 international passengers in the first half of 2024.

It is midway through a long modernisation running from 2015 to the mid 2030s, budgeted at about 586 million dollars, covering a new passenger terminal, an upgrade to the existing one, a rebuilt main runway and a relocated cargo terminal. A Chinese-built cargo centre able to handle 100,000 tonnes began operating in 2022, doubling the old capacity.

Passenger facilities include banks, cash machines, foreign exchange, restaurants, duty free and a left luggage office.
after:
Uganda's main international airport, and for now its only one, on the shore of Lake Victoria about 4 km south west of Entebbe town and around 40 km by road south west of central Kampala.

Plan for that road. The Civil Aviation Authority puts a taxi to Kampala at about 40 minutes, says the expressway is quicker and warns of heavy traffic in the mornings and evenings. Airport transfers are a real part of an itinerary rather than an afterthought.

The airport handled 2,243,104 international passengers in 2024, and more in 2025.

In December 2025 the Civil Aviation Authority said a new 20,000 square metre terminal was complete and would open in phases from January 2026, raising capacity to at least 3.5 million passengers a year. A Chinese-built cargo centre for 100,000 tonnes a year opened in 2022.

Passenger facilities include banks, cash machines, foreign exchange, restaurants and duty free.

claims.note: Was 'about 6 km' (Wikipedia). The operator gives the minibus trip from the airport to Entebbe town (Kitoro) as 4 km, and the coordinates put the airport 4.3 km in a straight line from the GeoNames centre of Entebbe (4 against 4.3, ratio 0.93, within the check). Wikipedia's 6 km would also pass as a road distance, but the operator's figure is the better source and fits the coordinates. The bearing is 249 degrees, west south west: Wikipedia's 'south west' is the adjacent compass point, within the check.

claims.claim: a Chinese-built cargo centre for 100,000 tonnes a year opened in 2022
claims.inAfter: A Chinese-built cargo centre for 100,000 tonnes a year opened in 2022.
claims.note: Xinhua reported the terminal open for business on 19 March 2022, with the authority's spokesman giving 100,000 tonnes a year against the old terminal's 50,000. The Independent (April 2024) quotes the authority as having completed the 100,000 tonne terminal. One line in the operator's December 2025 page ('this will increase the capacity to 100,000 metric tonnes with the opening of the new cargo terminal') is loosely worded, but read with the other three it does not say the terminal is unopened. The old text's 'doubling the old capacity' is sourced (Xinhua: 100,000 against 50,000 tonnes; Wikipedia) but left out for length.
